peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 20.2% below its local comparables; 8 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (90.2): 5.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 365 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $791,000 ($1,651 psf, 452–484 sq ft; 6 resales, Jun 2024–May 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,070 psf (range $1,814–2,612); 20.2% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $201,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Little India MRT about 150 m, Rochor MRT about 620 m; closer than 504 of 551 similar developments (the same as 3). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest ST. Margaret's School (Primary) about 340 m; more than 493 of 551 similar developments (the same as 48). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 440 m), more than 170 of 551 similar developments (the same as 41); nearest hawker centre Tekka Centre/Zhu Jiao Market about 320 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 170 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 300 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 410 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 580 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 700 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,260 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,370 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 1,520 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,540 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 384 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 111 new sales and 1,197 resales (1,308 purchases); new sales were 8.5% of these purchases. Subsales (56) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 390 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,090 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,280 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,380 m; The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 1,840 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,197 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 448 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,197 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,235 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−3.1%). Planning-area private resales −9.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
